answer:
Formulations associated with Vipadika

The available records associate Vipadika with the following formulations:

1. Sutshekhar Rasa [1]
2. Nalpamaradi Keram [2]
3. Mahatikta Ghrita [3]
4. Bashpa Sweda [4]
5. Kolakulathadi Churna [5]
6. Trivrit Lehyam [6]
7. Drakshadi Kashaya [7]
8. Mahatikta Lepa [8]
9. Aragvadhadi Kashaya [9]
10. Gandhak Rasayan [10]
11. Gandharvahastadi Eranda Taila [11]
